{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicates)
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_count}')

# Check sample_seq for re-tests
max_sample_seq_per_patient = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Max sample_seq per patient: {max_sample_seq_per_patient.max()}')"}
